dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 部屋が散らかっていて嫌になります
dialogue.English: My place is messy and it really gets me down.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは気になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, that must be bothersome.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自身のお部屋が散らかっているのですか？
dialogue.English: Is it your own room that's messy?

dialogue.content: 家の中全部です
dialogue.English: It's the entire house.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは落ち着かないですよね。いつ頃から片付かないのですか？
dialogue.English: I understand, that must make it hard to feel settled. How long has it been untidy?

dialogue.content: ずっとです
dialogue.English: For as long as I can remember.

dialogue.content: いくら片付けても子どもたちがメチャクチャにして、もう何もする気になれません
dialogue.English: No matter how much I tidy up, the kids just mess it all up again, and I lose the motivation to do anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、ちゃんと片づけはされているんですね。お子様は今おいくつですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you are making an effort to tidy up. How old are your children now?

dialogue.content: 上は7歳で小１、下は5歳で年長です
dialogue.English: The older one is 7 and in first grade, and the younger is 5 and in their last year of kindergarten.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お子様たちが遊んだ後、散らかったお部屋を見るとどんな気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. How do you feel when you see the messy room after the children have played?

dialogue.content: 何もかも嫌になります
dialogue.English: I get fed up with everything.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm, I can understand that.

dialogue.content: どなたかにそのお気持ちをお話ししましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone about how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: 話しても誰も助けてくれません
dialogue.English: Even if I talk to someone, no one helps me.

dialogue.content: なるほど。実際、誰かに話されてどういう反応でしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you did talk to someone, how did they respond?

dialogue.content: 夫は忙しいと言って、聞こうともしません
dialogue.English: My husband just says he's busy and won't even listen.

dialogue.content: それは、お辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他に誰か相談やお話を聞いてくれる方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone else you can talk to or who would listen to you?

dialogue.content: 実母に話しても役に立ちません
dialogue.English: Talking to my own mother is no help.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。一番頼りになるのはパートナー様かなと思いますが、パートナー様にこうなってほしいという思いはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Your partner would ideally be the person you can rely on most. Is there something you wish he would do, or a way you would like him to be?

dialogue.content: 朝早くに仕事に出かけて、帰ってきたら用意したご飯を食べてお風呂に入って寝るだけで、家事は何もしようとしません。自分のことくらい自分でやってくれたらと思います
dialogue.English: He leaves for work early in the morning, and when he comes home, he just eats the dinner I've prepared, takes a bath, and goes to sleep. He makes no effort to do any housework. I just wish he would at least take care of his own things.

dialogue.content: なるほど。パートナー様は仕事に忙しく、ほぼワンオペで育児・家事をされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So your partner is busy with work, and you're essentially handling all the childcare and housework by yourself.

dialogue.content: パートですが、仕事にも行っています
dialogue.English: I also have a part-time job.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、お仕事もされているんですね。体力的にもお辛いと思いますが、ちゃんと休息や睡眠などとれていますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you're working as well. That must be physically demanding. Are you able to get enough rest and sleep?

dialogue.content: あまり休めていません。下の子に手がかかって・・・
dialogue.English: I'm not getting much rest. The younger one is a handful...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはお辛いですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that must be very tough.

dialogue.content: 終わりでしょうか・・・？
dialogue.English: Is our time almost up...?

dialogue.content: パートナー様はあなたがどのように一日過ごされているのか、どんな感情か、どんなに大変か、おそらく把握できないように思います。
dialogue.English: It seems like your partner probably doesn't grasp how you spend your day, what you're feeling, or how difficult it is for you.

dialogue.content: はい、そう思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: お気持ちをお話しする時間をパートナー様と少しでも持てたらと思いますが、
dialogue.English: I think it would be good if you could have even a little time to talk about your feelings with your partner,

dialogue.content: 一人で抱えるのはお辛いですよね？
dialogue.English: it's hard to bear it all alone, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 会話やコミュニケーションがないと、日々どんな仕事をして、どんな感情で、どんなに大変かというのは、パートナー様は気付けてないと思います。
dialogue.English: Without conversation or communication, I don't think your partner can really grasp what you do each day, how you are feeling, or how difficult it is.

dialogue.content: そんなこと考えていないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think he thinks about that at all.

dialogue.content: 先日、子どもがインフルエンザで高熱を出し、私もうつされて体調を壊したのですが、それでも何もしてくれませんでした
dialogue.English: The other day, my child had a high fever from the flu, and I caught it and got sick too, but he still didn't do anything to help.

dialogue.content: それはひどいですね。そのお気持ちを素直に話せるといいですね。
dialogue.English: That sounds awful. It would be good if you could honestly tell him how you feel.

dialogue.content: 話を聞いていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。途中になってしまいまいましたが、お話しされていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. We had to stop partway, but how was it for you to talk about this?
